messages:
liam: Planning blue/green cutover for router service tonight 23:00 UTC. Rolling traffic to new route variant v2. Change window 1h. Start weights 5% -> 25% -> 75% -> 100%, 10m holds. Deploy-bot will execute shifts.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: router/edge-router @ 2026-03-21T23:00Z. Steps: warm pool, announce, set-weight, monitor metrics.

maya: Add hard abort thresholds: p95 latency +30% OR 5xx rate > 0.5% -> immediate rollback. Also capture heap/cuda metrics.

jordan-oncall: Agreed. Pin model variant rwd-ltr-1.1 for canary and fallback to rwd-ltr-1.0 on token-error spikes.

sasha: I'll watch traces and SLO dash. Make sure session affinity is preserved so demo users won't jump routes.

carlos: Router CLI snippet to run during shift: ```routerctl set-weight --route inference --variant v2 --weight 5 --region us-west-2``` then increment. Use `--dry-run` in staging.

liam: Change: canary at 5% for 10m (not 5m) to get enough samples. If stable -> 25% for 10m -> 75% for 10m -> drain. On issues, reweight back to v1 and notify.

deploy-bot: Executing warmup: creating 20 warm workers on v2 in us-west-2. ETA ~3m.

ops-bot: Alerting policies armed: latency-p95-high, 5xx-rate, token-errors. PagerDuty: jordan-oncall.

jordan-oncall: Rollback runbook (quick): `routerctl set-weight --route inference --variant v2 --weight 0` then `routerctl set-weight --route inference --variant v1 --weight 100` then `deploy-bot rollback --tag 1949876543` and open incident.

maya: :thumbsup: I'll run the preflight checklist at T-20 and post results here.

sasha: Note cost watch: v2 uses some fp16/custom kernels, may increase GPU time on certain long-context requests.

carlos: Dry-run in staging: `routerctl dry-run --route inference --variant v2 --target 5` -> OK, no errors.

deploy-bot: Shift started: set v2=5% global -> monitoring (root:1949876543).

sasha: 5m check: p95 +2%, 5xx 0.03% — holding.

jordan-oncall: 10m check: no token errors, traces look fine. Proceeding to 25%.

deploy-bot: Weight set to 25%.

maya: 25% hold 10m. Metrics nominal from us-west and us-east.

liam: Proceeding to 75% now.

deploy-bot: Weight set to 75%.

ops-bot: Alert: latency-p95-high firing in eu-west-1 (+45% vs baseline).

sasha: Seeing tail latency on long-context requests in eu-west traces. Looks like kernel fallback on some batch shapes.

jordan-oncall: Taking immediate action: partial rollback for eu-west only — set v2 weight eu-west=0, v1=100 in that region.

deploy-bot: Partial rollback executed for eu-west. Global weight now ~50% while we investigate.

carlos: That reduced sample in eu-west by ~6%. Leaving extra hold for 15m before any further changes.

liam: Decision: keep global at 50% and triage runtime kernel for eu-west. If 5xx or p95 keeps rising > thresholds, full rollback tonight.

maya: Flagging for postmortem if full rollback occurs. Save logs to `s3://redwood/deploys/1949876543/` and attach trace links.

sasha: Creating incident channel for eu-west perf: #inc-eu-west-router and adding eng-runtime.

jordan-oncall: I'll stay on call. If steady for 30m, resume ramp tomorrow after a runtime patch.

liam: Post-rollout tasks: update changelog, pin variant in infra config, schedule slow Dedicated rollout tomorrow. I'll notify product and support.

ops-bot: Status update: partial rollback successful in eu-west, global weight at 50%. Monitoring continues.

liam: Thanks all. I'll close the thread when we're back to steady-state and logs are archived.
